units.source_text: “我并不是检非违使的衙门里的公吏；

en.t: I am not an official from the office of the Kebiishi;

units.source_text: 只是刚才走过这闸下面的一个旅人。

en.t: I am only a traveler who happened to pass under this gate just now.

units.source_text: 所以并不要锁你去有什么事。

en.t: So I have no business tying you up and taking you away.

units.source_text: 只要在这时候，在这门上，做着什么的事，说给我就是。”

en.t: Just tell me what you were doing up here on this gate at this hour.
